import React from 'react'; import { Container, Typography, Paper, Grid, Card, CardContent, Button, Box, } from '@mui/material'; import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext'; import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'; const CompanyDashboard = () => { const { currentUser } = useAuth(); const navigate = useNavigate(); return ( Company Dashboard {/* Quick Actions */} Quick Actions {/* Company Summary */} Company Summary Name: {currentUser?.profile?.name || 'Not set'} Email: {currentUser?.email} Industry: {currentUser?.profile?.industry || 'Not set'} Status: {currentUser?.profile?.status || 'Pending'} {/* Recent Activity */} Welcome to Company Portal As a company partner, you can:
  • Post job opportunities for graduates
  • Review qualified applicants automatically matched by the system
  • Filter candidates based on academic performance and skills
  • Manage your company profile and job postings
 ); }; export default CompanyDashboard;
